title: Learn Solutions Engineering
tagline: From discovery demos to architectures customers will buy and run
description: A three-level curriculum for solutions engineers — translating customer problems into credible demos, technical designs, and mutual success plans that win deals and survive implementation.
prerequisites: Solid technical foundation in at least one domain (APIs, cloud, data, or security)
Comfort presenting to mixed technical and business audiences
Willingness to learn products deeply and admit what you do not know

levels.title: SE Foundations
levels.goal: Run discovery, deliver a crisp product demo, and capture requirements accurately

topics.title: Asking the right questions
items: Current state, constraints, and success metrics

topics.title: Qualification partnership
items: Working with AEs without becoming a salesperson-only

topics.title: Story-driven demos
items: Timeboxing and leaving room for questions

topics.title: Technical credibility
items: Explaining APIs, auth, and data flow simply
Handling “how do you integrate with X?”

topics.title: Write-ups that stick
items: Discovery notes and mutual action plans
Follow-up emails that advance the deal

projects: Discovery call role-play with notes and success criteria
15-minute persona demo with backup plan for a failure
One-page solution sketch for a sample customer problem
Mutual action plan template filled for a mock opportunity

levels.title: Solution Design & POVs
levels.goal: Own technical evaluations, POCs/POVs, and integration designs that de-risk purchase

topics.title: Designing fit
items: Reference architectures tailored to the customer
Security, privacy, and compliance talking points

topics.title: POV / POC management
items: Scoped success criteria before you start
Environment access, sample data, and timeline
Scoring results and recommending next steps

topics.title: RFPs & security reviews
items: Partnering with security and product for edge cases

topics.title: Working the account
items: Champion vs. economic buyer vs. blocker

projects: POV plan with success metrics, timeline, and owners
Workshop deck for a technical evaluation committee

levels.title: Strategic Solutions Leadership
levels.goal: Shape complex deals, product feedback loops, and reusable SE playbooks at scale

topics.title: Enterprise pursuits
items: Phased rollout and value realization plans
Executive briefings that stay technical enough

topics.title: Risk & negotiation support
items: Saying no while preserving the relationship

topics.title: SE systems
items: Onboarding new SEs and certification paths

topics.title: Product partnership
items: Structured product feedback from the field
Competitive intelligence that product can use

topics.title: Influence
items: Prioritizing SE time across a pipeline
Building trust as the technical voice of the customer

projects: Enterprise pursuit pack: architecture, POV, exec brief, MAP
SE playbook (discovery, demo, POV, handoff) for your product
Win/loss technical retro with product recommendations
Reusable demo environment + asset library design
